title: Watch PR
line: See what still needs attention on a pull request.

beats.caption: You ask what’s outstanding on the sample PR.
Watch PR finds a thread even with a green check.
beats.label: pi-watch-pr

beats.caption: The agent points you to the outstanding comment.

takeaway.title: Read the verdict for this commit
takeaway.line: The report ties checks and review threads to the PR head.

notes: The sample GitHub checks and thread come from a local CLI fixture. The real extension calculates the verdict.

title.text: When a test goes green, there can still be a review comment waiting on the pull request.

scene.text: Using a sample pull request, Watch PR checks the current commit and its reviews. The test passed, but a comment in the command line file still needs a response.

takeaway.text: The report names the commit, check results, and open threads. You can see what needs attention before you merge.
